name: Minami-Sunamachi
tagline: Otemachi in 15 minutes and Tokyo in 21 minutes. Served by 1 line. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000.
summary: The station is in Koto City, where Tokyo Metro run 1 line between them. Journey times to the main business districts are 15 minutes to Otemachi, 35 minutes to Shinjuku, 39 minutes to Shibuya and 35 minutes to Shinagawa. A one-room flat rents for roughly ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. The station stands 0.7 m above sea level, and the ground within 800 m varies in height by 6.1 m. The land around the station is close to level.

terrain.note: The station sits on the higher side of the ground around it, at 0.7 m above sea level. Within 800 m the ground ranges from -2.6 m to 3.5 m, a difference of 6.1 m.

hazards: On the flood hazard map for the largest rainfall the government models, the station itself falls inside the projected inundation area, to a projected depth of 0.5 to 3 m. Of the nine points within 400 m of the station, 7 also fall inside the area, and the deepest projection is 5 to 10 m. For storm surge, 8 of the nine points also fall inside the projected area. On the whole, the flood projection here is on the large side for the 23 wards.

medical: Within an 800 m walk of the station there are 2 clinics and 5 pharmacies. The nearest hospital is 順天堂東京江東高齢者医療センター, about 8 minutes' walk from the station. The next nearest is 東京都立東部療育センター, about 10 minutes' walk. "Hospital" here means a facility OpenStreetMap records as one. OpenStreetMap does not record whether a facility admits inpatients or which departments it runs, so check each one on its own website. For which clinics open at night and at weekends, ask the emergency advice line of the ward you live in.
stationNote: 1 line serve the station: Tokyo Metro Tozai Line.
congestion: Tokyo Metro Tozai Line runs at 160% of capacity in the morning peak. The busiest stretch is 木場→門前仲町, which this station is not on. At 150%, the ministry's scale describes shoulders not quite touching, with crowding near the doors. The figures describe each line's busiest stretch, so the stretch you ride may be easier.

rentRange.note: Around this station, One room ¥100,000 to ¥110,000 and 1K ¥100,000 to ¥110,000. 1LDK ¥150,000 to ¥160,000 and 2LDK ¥200,000 to ¥210,000. These are the per-station averages published by LIFULL HOME'S, Yahoo! Real Estate and at home, averaged together and rounded down to the nearest ¥10,000 (our own survey). All three are asking rents, so what tenants finally agree can be lower. Within the same station area the figure moves a great deal with the age of the building, the walk from the station, and whether the flat faces a main road.

leads.terrain: The ground around the station is almost level, so you can choose where to live without thinking about slopes.
leads.groceries: There are 3 supermarkets within walking distance, and the nearest is 10 minutes on foot.
leads.hazards: The station itself sits inside the area projected to flood in the heaviest rainfall the government models.
leads.stationNote: Only the Tokyo Metro Tozai Line serves this station, so when it stops you walk to another station.
leads.rentRange: Set against how long the commute takes, rents here are on the low side.
leads.medical: The number of clinics and pharmacies within walking distance is about average for the 23 wards.
leads.congestion: Among the 23 wards' stations, the lines here are heavily loaded in the morning.
leads.noiseSources: At this station, check the traffic noise before the noise people make.
